summary: Pearson plc furnished a Form 6-K announcing three non-executive board appointments effective 1 October 2026: Michael Barkin and Vivek Sharma as independent NEDs and Alex Svensson, a Cevian Capital partner, as a NED under a relationship agreement, joining the Nomination and Governance Committee. Chair Omid Kordestani cited financial, AI and technology expertise, and recognition of Cevian as Pearson's largest shareholder after six years of engagement. No price, stake, premium or close date is stated. This is routine board refreshment, not a special situation; watch for Cevian's influence on capital allocation.
